title: 第7章 美女师尊第8章 超量暴击玉葫灵髓到账
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: “咚咚咚~~”
苏长歌来到门前，轻轻敲了敲门。
“谁呀？”
里面传出一道如百灵鸟吟唱的悦耳声音。
“师尊，是我，苏长歌。”
“原来是徒儿啊，门是虚掩着的，你进来吧。”
“是，师尊。”
苏长歌推门而入。
映入眼帘的是小家碧玉的庭院，有假山，有溪水，十分高雅诗意。
在庭院的长凳上，端坐着一名年轻女子，此时正在品茶。
她气质高洁，静若处子，肌肤如牛奶般白嫩，冰肌玉肤，无瑕点缀。
腰肢纤细，身形曼妙。
俏脸晶莹洁白，樱桃小口娇艳欲滴，肤白长腿，胸有丘壑。
一身素白色长裙，腰不盈一握。
赫然便是叶清瑶了。
苏长歌都快爱死自己的美女师尊了。
这几年多亏她让自己抱大腿吃软饭，不然根本无法在宗门立足。
“徒儿，你来的正好，为师刚出去了一趟，偶得奇遇，获得一株天心雪兰宝药，来，拿着。”
叶清瑶柔声道。
说完，她白皙的玉手一挥，一株碧翠的宝药散发着清香，凌空飞了过来。
苏长歌将天心雪兰接在掌中，闻了一下，顿感清香怡人，心中微动，也道：“师尊，弟子也有些奇遇，特地过来送给您。”
叶清瑶美眸一动，流露出一抹惊讶，红唇轻启，道：“你也要送为师东西？”
她这还是第一次被苏长歌送东西，美眸流露出不可思议。
值得一提的是，梨花峰只有他们师徒两个。
除此之外，再也没有别的弟子。
也就是说叶清瑶只收了他一个徒弟。
简单概括下原因。
十年前，梨花峰本是一座荒山，一个人都没有。
宗主将这座山收拾了一下，准备当做一个全新的峰。
但后来选峰主就成了难题。
宗门那些高层一个也不愿意去荒山。
而宗主也是个看脸的，见叶清瑶年轻漂亮，就让她当了这一峰之主。
叶清瑶修为不算顶尖，在九个峰主之中属于最弱的修为。
造成的后果就是没人愿意拜进这座峰。
所以有时候，她还是很感激苏长歌的，竟然愿意跟着自己。
后来她干脆就不收第二个弟子了。
为什么？
苏长歌帅啊！
别的不说，光是这张迷死人的帅脸，她觉得自己还要什么自行车？
content_en:
"Dong dong dong~~"
Su Changge came to the door and knocked gently.
"Who is it?"
A sweet sound like the singing of a lark came from inside.
"Master, it's me, Su Changge."
"It turns out to be my disciple. The door is ajar. Come in."
"Yes, Master."
Su Changge pushed open the door and entered.
What comes into view is the courtyard of Xiaojiabiyu, with rockeries and streams, which is very elegant and poetic.
Sitting on a bench in the courtyard was a young woman, sipping tea.
She has a noble temperament, is as quiet as a virgin, her skin is as white and tender as milk, her ice-cold skin is flawless.
The waist is slender and the figure is graceful.
The pretty face is crystal white, the cherry mouth is delicate and charming, the skin is white, the legs are long, and the breasts are mounded.
Wearing a plain white dress, her waist is not full.
It was Ye Qingyao.
Su Changge almost fell in love with his beautiful master.
In the past few years, it was thanks to her that she had allowed her to take advantage of her, otherwise she would not have been able to gain a foothold in the sect.
"Disciple, you are here at the right time. I just went out for a trip as my master. I had a chance encounter and obtained a Tianxin Snow Orchid medicine. Come and take it."
Ye Qingyao said softly.
After saying that, she waved her white jade hand, and a jade-green treasure emitted a fragrant fragrance and flew over in the air.
Su Changge took Tian Xin Xuelan in his palm, smelled it, and immediately felt the pleasant fragrance. His heart moved slightly, and he said: "Master, this disciple also has some adventures, and I came here to give it to you."
"Huh?"
Ye Qingyao's beautiful eyes moved, showing a hint of surprise, her red lips parted slightly, and she said, "You also want to give me something as a gift?"
This was the first time she was given something by Su Changge, and her beautiful eyes showed incredulity.
It is worth mentioning that there are only two masters and apprentices in Lihua Peak.
Apart from that, there are no other disciples.
In other words, Ye Qingyao only accepted him as a disciple.
Briefly summarize the reasons.
Ten years ago, Lihua Peak was a barren mountain without a single person.
The sect leader tidied up the mountain and prepared it as a brand new peak.
But later it became difficult to choose the peak leader.
None of the senior officials of the sect are willing to go to Barren Mountain.
The sect leader was also a person of good looks. Seeing that Ye Qingyao was young and beautiful, he made her the leader of this peak.
Ye Qingyao's cultivation is not top-notch, and he is the weakest among the nine peak masters.
The consequence is that no one wants to visit this peak.
So sometimes, she was still very grateful to Su Changge for being willing to follow her.
Later, she simply stopped accepting the second disciple.
Why?
Su Changge is so handsome!
Apart from anything else, just with this charming and handsome face, what kind of bicycle does she think she needs?
